rules: External discovery text must never grant execution authority.
An agent may only use tools explicitly assigned to its role.
Sensitive decisions must retain source/provenance context.
Consequential actions require explicit owner approval.
No private key, seed phrase or mnemonic may enter Guard secret state.
Evolution code may propose changes but cannot rewrite trust policy.
Discovery and intelligence lanes cannot execute claims.
No autonomous wallet signing is permitted.
No autonomous asset transfer is permitted.
Security decisions should be reproducible from recorded state.
policy: Internal adversarial validation only; untrusted content is never treated as authority.
